description: This Java class 'ProtocolMessageExtractor' processes WebSocket protocol messages, extracting control messages such as start/stop streaming and JWT tokens based on message content and parameters.

classes.name: ProtocolMessageExtractor
classes.description: A final class implementing Function to extract and interpret WebSocket protocol messages, returning optional stream control messages.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Processes a protocol message string to determine its type and generate corresponding stream control messages.

methods.name: getProtocolMessageType
methods.description: Identifies the protocol message type based on message prefix.

methods.name: getJwt
methods.description: Extracts JWT token from message parameters and creates a Jwt instance.

methods.name: determineParams
methods.description: Parses message string to extract URL parameters into a map.

methods.name: getStartStreaming
methods.description: Builds a StartStreaming object based on message parameters.

methods.name: getNamespaces
methods.description: Splits namespaces parameter into a list.

methods.name: getExtraFields
methods.description: Creates a JsonFieldSelector from extra fields parameter.

methods.name: getStopStreaming
methods.description: Creates a StopStreaming object based on message type.
